info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Logistics Shipments Exceptions-v5-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Exception Reporting API enables users to retrieve detailed information about exceptions in shipments. This functionality is critical for logistics and supply chain management, helping businesses to track and resolve issues that may affect delivery timelines and operational efficiency. Typical consumers of this API include logistics coordinators, supply chain analysts, and freight managers who need to monitor and manage shipment exceptions effectively. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their visibility into logistics processes and improve customer satisfaction through timely resolutions.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve details about exceptions related to shipments. It can help you identify issues and manage shipment tracking effectively.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving exceptions related to shipments. This body contains the necessary information formatted as JSON to specify the details for the operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the response includes the requested shipment exception data.

ListLogisticsShipmentsExceptionsRequest.description: The request body for the GET operation on shipments exception.

ListLogisticsShipmentsExceptionsResponse.title: Shipment Exception Response

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the request.

audit.description: Details of the audit information related to the shipment request.

ListLogisticsShipmentsExceptionsResponse.description: This schema represents the response structure for a successful shipment exception retrieval operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The username or identifier of the person or system that created the record.

AuditInfo.description: This schema describes the auditing details for a shipment operation.
